data.name: Muhaqqiq
data.gender_notes: Muhaqqiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muhaqqiq is an Arabic name that means 'one who seeks the truth' or 'a researcher'. It is a name that symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name Muhaqqiq carries the meaning “Truth Seeker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhaqqiq usually hope their child will grow to embody truth seeker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The concept of seeking truth is emphasized in Islam, as Muslims are encouraged to seek knowledge and understand the Quran and Hadith.
data.etymology: Muhaqqiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truth Seeker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaqqiq total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
